superseded_statements.old_statement: Derived authority results may be memoized per authority object identity plus content (v1.6 authority_lib: qualification keyed on id(caps)/id(es)/id(rp), the primitive-spec digest keyed on the read-primitive object, the evidence record index keyed on the evidence set, the parser identity computed once per process).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 BLOCKER C16-B1: an object identity is not its content. Mutating a qualified chain in place left the warm answer QUALIFIED_CALLABLE while a cold process refused, so two evaluators reading the same bytes disagreed.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The composed validation path requires the caller to supply a schema validator, and requiring it (rather than defaulting it) makes schema enforcement mandatory (v1.6 F15-04 correction).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 BLOCKER C16-B2: a required parameter still lets the caller define validity. An always-empty, partial, permissive or stale validator authorized an invalid commit manifest. The authority now owns the law and refuses any caller-supplied validator by name.

superseded_statements.old_statement: A raw capture records its capture shim version and shim sha256 as provenance facts (v1.6 RAW-CAPTURE.md, CAPTURE-SHIM.md).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 BLOCKER C16-B3: recorded provenance that nothing compares is not provenance. A capture declaring any shim hash qualified. The bundle now pins one trusted shim and refuses every other, and the active authority must name it.

superseded_statements.old_statement: A stored derived capability result is a cache: qualification recomputes it and compares digests, and any stored copy must equal the recomputation (v1.6 REVIEW-REFREEZE.md).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 BLOCKER C16-B4: comparing digests closes forgery of the value but not substitution of the artifact. A claimed derived artifact that was absent, or that belonged to another raw capture, still authorized, and multiple current reviews or refreeze records were selected implicitly.

superseded_statements.old_statement: Identity claims are derived by mapping each observed receiver path to its returned identity value within a pass, and claim C compares those maps across passes (v1.6 IDENTITY-EVIDENCE.md).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 M0A MAJOR C16-M1: writing each observation into a map keyed by receiver path let a duplicate path overwrite the first observation, so the conflict disappeared and uniqueness was asserted over a pass that had observed one path twice. Stability was also asserted while uniqueness was false.

superseded_statements.old_statement: A RAW_CAPABILITY_CAPTURE enters the authority as a parsed capture object whose structure and digest are validated (v1.6 RAW-CAPTURE.md).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 M0A MAJOR C16-M2: a parsed object cannot show that duplicate JSON keys, control characters or trailing bytes were ever rejected, and the standard parser silently keeps the last duplicate key. Raw evidence now enters only as bytes through one strict boundary that leaves a receipt.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The append-only evidence root is defined by the layout and rules of EVIDENCE-ROOT.md, with EvidenceRoot in the reference capture shim as an illustration (v1.6).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.6 M0A MAJOR C16-M3: the layout was prose. Nothing could be run to prove that an evidence root refuses an overwrite, a reused attempt id, a write after finalization or a replaced record. The law is now executable and the validator attacks it.

superseded_statements.old_statement: An evidence session is verified by recomputing the digests of the records the verifier expects to find: record files under the four layers, the session manifest, the attempts index and HASHES.json (v1.7 tools/evidence_store.py#verify).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.7 BLOCKER ES-1, independent attack STORE-14: a verifier that only examines what it expects cannot notice what it does not. A file planted in a finalized session root was ignored and verification returned clean. Finalization now records the complete allowed inventory of every governed file and directory, and verification requires missing == 0, unexpected == 0 and changed == 0.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The append-only evidence root has a reference implementation in the capture shim (EvidenceRoot in tools/capture_shim_reference.py) alongside the normative executable store (v1.6 S45, carried into v1.7).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.7 BLOCKER ES-2: two competing evidence-storage surfaces existed, and the legacy one built filesystem paths from caller-supplied strings. All four of its write methods escaped the evidence root on '../../x'. EvidenceRoot is removed; exactly one module is EVIDENCE_STORE_AUTHORIZING, and no caller anywhere supplies a path.

superseded_statements.old_statement: An evidence root and a session directory are located by resolving the caller-supplied path (os.path.realpath) and then confining every component beneath the resolved base; symlinks inside the session are rejected (v1.8 tools/evidence_store.py).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.8 BLOCKER S19-1: resolving first destroys the evidence needed to refuse. A symlinked evidence root was resolved away and a session was created, finalized and verified through it. The trust boundary is now established by lstat before any resolution, the literal path is kept, and the root's device and inode are re-checked on every operation.

superseded_statements.old_statement: A finalized evidence session is verified as a closed world of paths, digests, byte counts and directories, with attempt uniqueness keyed on the attempt id bound to a record digest (v1.8 S46 and tools/evidence_store.py).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.8 BLOCKERs S19-2 and S19-3 and MAJOR S19-4: bytes alone are not identity. A renamed session directory verified clean, one attempt id produced records in two layers, and chmod after finalization was invisible. v1.9 freezes a session identity tuple and the basename-is-session-id path law, derives each record's name from its semantics, keys attempt uniqueness on (session, layer, logical identity, attempt id), records POSIX file type and permission mode, and adds a fourth verification counter, semantic_mismatch, which must also be zero.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The evidence root trust boundary is established by lstat at open time and held in process memory as a RootBoundary, whose device and inode are re-checked on later operations (v1.9 S48).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.9 BLOCKER S110-1: a boundary that exists only in memory cannot survive the process that built it. Replacing a finalized session directory with another of the same basename and content verified clean, and copying the session under a second root verified clean. v1.10 persists a SESSION_BOUNDARY receipt as governed evidence, binds root and session directory identity into the session identity tuple, and re-lstats both against the receipt before every authorizing operation.

superseded_statements.old_statement: A finalized session is verified by comparing the stored inventory against the filesystem, with stored attempt markers, directory entries and finalization-marker fields taken as recorded (v1.9 S49).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.9 BLOCKERs S110-2 and S110-3 and MAJOR S110-4: recording a field and then trusting it is not verification. Finalization-marker store and authority versions were ignored, a foreign attempt marker planted on disk was accepted through write, finalize and verify, directory semantics were partly self-asserted, and mode drift before finalization went unnoticed. v1.10 recomputes the expected model from filesystem facts, record bytes, the session manifest, the boundary receipt and frozen store law, reconciles markers and records as a bijection, derives every mode from entry kind and enforces it continuously, and publishes a provenance table forbidding any normative field from being trusted from the inventory itself.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The persisted SESSION_BOUNDARY receipt is authoritative once its own boundary_sha256 recomputes over its stored bytes and its field set is canonical (v1.10 S50).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.10 BLOCKER F110-A: digest consistency is not semantic truth. Five receipt fields - schema, evidence_store_version, authority_version, platform_scope and created_at - were stored and digested but never compared outside the receipt, so rewriting one and recomputing boundary_sha256 left the next put_raw() authorized. v1.11 classifies every field with exactly one provenance class, reconciles every normative one against the frozen constant or filesystem fact it claims, and classifies created_at INFORMATIONAL_NON_AUTHORIZING because this store governs no independent creation-event authority.

superseded_statements.old_statement: The stored inventory is verified by comparing its recorded entries, directories and nine normative header fields against the independently recomputed model, and additional top-level fields are tolerated (v1.10 S51).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.10 BLOCKER F110-B: six normative header fields - record_count, entry_count, total_bytes, attempt_count, self_path and finalized_marker_path - were written, digested, published as derived and never compared, and an extra semantic top-level field survived verification. v1.11 freezes the exact inventory vocabulary (a missing, unknown, duplicate or mistyped field is INVENTORY_FIELD_SET_INVALID), recomputes all six from the independent model and the frozen store layout, and moves the inventory schema from v3 to v4 so semantic extension is a version and not an extra key.

superseded_statements.old_statement: Stored attempt markers and records reconcile as a bijection: every marker resolves to a record whose semantic key recomputes from the marker tuple, and every record has such a marker (v1.10 L7).
superseded_statements.reason: Codex v1.10 BLOCKER F110-C: the claim was one-to-one but only the one-record-per-marker direction was enforced. Two distinct attempt ids over the same session, layer, logical identity and bytes produced two valid markers resolving to one content-addressed record, and finalize() and verify() both passed. v1.11 requires EXACT cardinality in both directions - zero is ORPHANED_RECORD, more than one is MARKER_CARDINALITY_VIOLATION - and refuses the second write before any ambiguous state is persisted, so the public API and the persisted verifier enforce the same rule.

superseded_statements.old_statement: check_boundary() is called before every authorizing operation, and read and model accessors evaluate their own preconditions (v1.10 L3).
